# 佛說放鉢經

**ID:** T0629
**Volume:** T15
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 闕譯
**Date:** 265–316
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0629

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T629 (one fascicle; Sanskrit *Ajātaśatrukaukṛtyavinodana-sūtra*) is a short Chinese version of an episode from the *Ajātaśatru* cycle, transmitted as an anonymous translation. The *[Chū sānzàng jì jí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0084)* (T2145) lists it among the texts whose translator was already lost by [僧祐](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E7%A5%90) Sēngyòu's day; the Taishō edition assigns it conventionally to the Western Jin (265–316) on the basis of its translation style.

**Abstract**

T629 is a single episode — the "letting go of the bowl" miracle, in which the Buddha causes Mahāmaudgalyāyana to attempt to retrieve a begging-bowl that has descended to the bottom of the universe, only for the bowl to remain immovable in defiance of all śrāvaka power until the bodhisattva [Mañjuśrī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%87%E6%AE%8A) retrieves it with his fingertip. This narrative occurs in expanded form in [T626](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0263), [T627](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0264) and [T628](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0265) as part of the larger *Ajātaśatru-paripṛcchā*; T629 isolates and circulates this episode separately. The Sēngyòu catalog already classes it as 失譯 ("translator unknown"); modern philological work has not been able to attach it to any known translator with confidence. The *[Kāiyuán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0093)* catalog (T2154) and the *Zhēnyuán* catalog (T2157) follow Sēngyòu's classification. Date bracket follows the Taishō convention of placing it in the Western Jin on stylistic grounds.
